name: Big Chalk Nature Recovery Fund

funder.name: Big Chalk partnership (Protected Landscapes Partnership, supported by Defra)

summary: Capital grants to create, restore and connect habitats such as species-rich grassland, ancient woodland and chalk streams on chalk and limestone landscapes across southern England, assessed on a rolling basis.

calls.label: Rolling applications

status.quote: Organisations and individuals working to restore nature in southern England can apply now for grants of up to £100,000

calls.note: Projects would normally need to be completed by 31 March 2027.

applicant_types.quote: We welcome applications from environmental charities, farmers, land managers and landowners, community groups, local authorities, parish and town councils, educational institutions that manage land, and collaborative partnerships working within chalk and limestone landscapes.

geography.quote: The fund supports nature recovery projects across southern England on chalk and limestone geology

access.quote: Submit an Expression of Interest - tell us about your project, what you want to achieve and how it will benefit nature.

amount.quote: Capital grants from £1,000 to £100,000, with larger awards available exceptionally

co_finance_required.quote: The fund can contribute up to 80% of project costs (exceptionally up to 100%)
